notes.title: 1.1.5 Update - Better Custom Levels!
notes.content: You can now draw your own layouts for custom maps (while still making use of the game's procedural-content-based trappings) - for bonus points, you can now also export/import your custom challenges to share them with others!

notes.title: The 1.1 Update is live!
notes.content:
The [b]biggest update so far[/b] to Not the Robots has just gone online!

[img=http://i.imgur.com/58BAe3B.jpg]

Some highlights:

* Our community's most-requested feature: [b]Save&Quit for Campaign Mode[/b]
* We ported the game to our first Android device (Amazon's FireTV) - as a carryover benefit, desktop users who weren't already running the game on max settings should see a [b]general performance boost[/b]
* A overhaul to the general loading screen with tips & tricks, cooler transitions, and one of those fun "loading spinner" animations
* Revamped background decorations during gameplay (probably the ugliest part of the original game!)
* The "Unlock All" cheat code now unlocks [b]You Find Yourself In A Room 2[/b], a hidden sequel that was previously only accessible by completing all 20 Challenge levels
* [b]Many other tweaks and improvements[/b], including an improved "x-ray" effect for the player character, prettier spacial UI elements (like Scanners, Sequence numbers, and tutorial popups), and more

[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1U3Wb4NAuYnmh5KxdiDYXb5IlUaLWbDQOf2upc7GAMY4]The full changelog is available here[/url]
